howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会读取 golden_chat_single 的 Slack 聊天记录（fixtures/slack-export/，#general 频道 1 条消息），回答涉及这段对话的问题时参考 references/main.md。
howto.when: 当你需要从 golden_chat_single 聊天记录里找讨论、代码片段或排查步骤等内容时触发。

say.text: 在 golden_chat_single 里找 #general 频道的讨论
把 references/main.md 里的消息内容念给我

say.text: 这份聊天记录里有没有分享的链接？

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads the golden_chat_single Slack export (fixtures/slack-export/, 1 message in #general) and consults references/main.md when answering questions about that chat history.
howto.when_en: Use it when you need to look up discussions, code snippets, troubleshooting steps and more from the golden_chat_single chat history.

say_en.text: Read me the messages in references/main.md
say_en.note: Outputs the original messages from that archive

say_en.text: Are there any shared links in this chat history?
say_en.note: Answers from the reference files; says 0 if none
